Existing full-path tests use a mock whose probe returns false, so after migration they are IIncrementalSource with probe false; the type-test branch is unpinned. An implementation casting unconditionally, or dropping the type test, still passes every listed test. Oracle pins the type of the connectors only by reflection, not the route.
